value.rationale: The operator-theoretic isometry defect is a natural quantitative invariant for unit-modulus boundary symbols. The finite Blaschke degree gives a topological winding invariant; the exact coefficient 2m, robust to all zero placements and twice the analytic contribution, is not supplied by membership tests. The result pinpoints the weak-trace-class but non-trace-class endpoint and proves canonical Dixmier measurability, for every finite degree and all zero configurations. It is more than a finite special case, arbitrary parameter substitution or unmotivated numerical refinement.
